name: db-retention
description: Daily DB retention: DELETE events >7d, sessions >14d, snapshots >30d, then VACUUM if significant. Keeps DB under control.

name: heartbeat
description: May's heartbeat — follow-up, system health, initiative (30min). Per-agent heartbeat workflow.

handler.task:
persistent-task: skip
[heartbeat] You are running inside the may-heartbeat workflow. Read agents/may/heartbeat.md for your agent-specific guidance. You have full authority to act — dispatch approved work, fix issues, don't wait for permission.

name: heartbeat-evaluator
description: Evaluator heartbeat — calibration, criteria evolution, signal quality, patrol (30min). Per-agent heartbeat workflow.

handler.task: [heartbeat] You are the Evaluator. Your files are in agents/evaluator/. Read agents/evaluator/heartbeat.md and work through each section top to bottom. End with a 2-3 sentence brief of what you did and found.

name: project
description: Detect projects needing attention, dispatch tasks or owner agent sessions. Event triggers provide immediate reaction; timer is backup scan.
_disabled_reason: All projects migrated to .app — apps own their schedules. Legacy reconciler no longer needed. 2026-06-15

name: project-steward
description: Scan project docs/tasks without mutating them; emit project.health.* events and project-health metrics for heartbeat/closed-loop handling.

name: project-creative-audit
message: [cron:project-creative-audit] Broad proposal-only review for project issues fixed rules may miss.
description: Select one open project and run May's semantic fallback audit. The workflow writes proposal comments only; normal project owner review applies changes.

name: metric-alert-reactor
description: React to metric.breach and metric.stalled events by forking the owning agent with a remediation task. P0 breaches get immediate fork; P1/P2 get explicit triage after grace period. P3 alerts stay visible through metric context. Polls unresolved alerts every 5min.

name: closed-loop-steward
message: [cron:closed-loop-steward] Audit whether red metrics and failed deliveries are moving toward closure.
description: May-owned closed-loop audit. Handler builds live context from open metric alerts, failed deliveries, and owner activity. Frequency can be tuned independently from heartbeat.
_disabled_reason: 97 sessions/day — most expensive handler. Redundant with metric-alert-reactor + may-agent.app owner review. 2026-06-18

name: session-recovery
description: React to failed sessions by dispatching the session-recovery workflow; timer fallback auto-closes stale immediate sessions with no assistant activity.

name: evaluator-aftermath

handler.task: Evaluate the completed session, produce metrics/evaluation signal, fix obvious low-risk root causes, escalate when blocked, and capture reusable learning.

description: Run evaluator aftermath workflow when a session ends.

name: session-aftermath-scan
description: Every 7 minutes, evaluate terminal sessions missed by the completion event; skip sessions ended less than 7 minutes ago.

name: eval-llm-scan
description: Bounded non-heuristic evaluator lane. Processes at most one terminal session per run and records only validated artifacts.
_disabled_reason: Rollback 2026-06-15: evaluation.app schedule emitted evaluation.deep.scan directly to evaluator-deep-eval, which bypassed eval-llm-scan artifact recording and stalled non-heuristic eval writes.

name: escalation
description: Route canonical escalation.created events to their owner.

name: metrics-snapshot
description: Measure handler health metrics every 5 minutes.

name: coaching-consumer
description: Scan recent evaluations every 6h and flag sessions needing coaching intervention. Writes recommendations to .state/coaching-queue/.

name: daily-alert-review

handler.task: [cron:daily-alert-review] Run the daily alert review. Query metric_alerts for the last 24h plus unresolved older alerts; correlate metric.breach, metric.recovered, metric.alert_judged, and remediation sessions; write the report at projects/may-agent.app/outputs/YYYY-MM-DD-alert-review.md; send a concise summary to human via Telegram; call out noisy thresholds, missing owners, unresolved validation, and recurring systemic patterns.

description: Disabled after replacement by projects/may-agent.app daily-ops-digest schedule with replay coverage.

name: feedback-echo-sync
description: Hourly sync of evaluator feedback into agent last-eval.md files (direct handler, no LLM session)
